claim_scope: backend-exclusive fixed-B4 continuous D512 GPU-resident decode with structural graph-bank pre-capture; excludes model load, prefill, capture, cache restore/scrub, and preconditioning

timed_work.host_planner_behavior: supported FlashInfer plan performs D2H metadata reads and host scheduling at each page-boundary rebuild; these stream-idle gaps are inside both CUDA-event and wall-clock intervals

cuda_graph_provenance.graph_pool_policy: one shared serial-replay pool per structural plan signature
cuda_graph_provenance.capture_memory_scope: graph-bank-only delta after exhaustive preflight; worker-level before/after records are authoritative for total startup cost
cuda_graph_provenance.position_guard: actual FlashInfer _plan_info topology plus stable wrapper, cache, scratch, RoPE-table, and device-position pointers
cuda_graph_provenance.device_position_updates: one persistent CUDA int32 scalar fill inside each decoder step
cuda_graph_provenance.page_table_allocator_invariant: monotone request-major identity allocation; every table-content change coincides with active-page-count or exact-slice identity
cuda_graph_provenance.general_allocator_requirement: eviction, compaction, or same-shape page remapping requires an explicit host page-table epoch in the plan-rebuild key
cuda_graph_provenance.captured_model_lifecycle_invariant: model packing and CUDA placement complete before capture; model, decoder, parameter, bias, and module-buffer objects remain alive and immutable with no to(), repack, parameter replacement, or torch.cuda.empty_cache() after capture

precondition.exact_prefix_attestation: covered jointly by the post-sample canary so no candidate-only digest perturbs the hot precondition
covered jointly by the post-sample canary so no candidate-only digest perturbs the hot precondition

exclusivity.hf_dynamic_cache_scope: one B1 request during coherent fixture construction only

cache_build.sink_storage_accounting: legacy alias: no exact prefix allocation

token_source.continuation_semantics: prefix is positions [0,context); decode position context and all later decode IDs are actual WikiText tokens; each decode logit at input position p is labeled by position p+1
token_source.label_alignment: decode input at model position context+s predicts the true corpus token at model position context+s+1

sampled_parameters.method: up to 64 systematic values from every named parameter
